notes.title: Local multiplayer added as a preview and bug fixes
notes.notes: Patch 1.1 is now online with local multiplayer as a preview - just select "Multiplayer" from the main menu. There may be an issue where you have to select "Shootout" for the mission. The patch also fixes some memory issues.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 improves German translation and adds new terrain textures
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.3 is online now with the following changes:


 Mission texts also available in German
 New savegames may use additional terrain textures (old savegames keep the default texture)
 UI tweaks

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 is now online
notes.notes:
Version 1.02 is out, highlights include:


 Fixed a bug with line edits where the backspace key would corrupt the string in the line edit
 Controller hotplugging works now
 Black splash screen removed - options and statistics can now be accessed from the shell
 UI tweaks
 Reduced flickering on enemy damage indicator
